subject: MAP: Integration build plan - SDK/streaming/tool-calling owners & target close
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Bob Turner <bob.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call MAP draft: Integration build plan (owners + next steps)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on integration approach. Per our discussion, I put together a short MAP milestone for the "Integration build plan" with proposed owners, key dependencies, and a target close date. See the highlights below and the attached MAP workbook (redwood-map-integration-MAP-v1.xlsx) with the draft timeline.

Milestone: Integration build plan (SDK integration, streaming, tool-calling, structured outputs)
- Target close: 2027-05-15 (we used your suggested pilot window as the baseline)
- Owners (Redwood):
  - SDK integration (client-side auth, install flow): Dev Patel (dev.patel@redwood.ai)
  - Streaming & real-time token handling: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai)
  - Tool calling / structured outputs (schema + tool contract): Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.ai)
- Customer owners (tentative): Alice Zhang (platform lead), Bob Turner (infra)
- Dependencies:
  1) API key + workspace provisioning (we need ACME's service account + IP allowlist)
  2) Security questionnaire answers (SOC 2 excerpt & network checklist)
  3) Schema for structured outputs (example invoice/manifest proto)
  4) Test dataset and streaming SLAs defined

Action items (short):
- Marissa: update MAP and share final workbook (attached) — DONE (v1)
- Alice: confirm customer owners and any network windows for testing
- Bob: confirm IP ranges and whether a proxy is required for streaming
- Dev / Rishi / Laura: review and comment on effort estimates in the workbook

Next steps: Please review the attached MAP v1. If owners + dependencies look right, reply with any timeline changes and we can lock the internal sprint commitments. If helpful, we can run a short tech scoping call next week (30m).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-map-integration-MAP-v1.xlsx, sdk-integration-spec.pdf
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call MAP draft: Integration build plan (owners + next steps)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and matches our expectations. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Target close: 2027-05-15 is fine as a target for the integration plan, but we may need a short pilot window after that. If we hit blockers on streaming (proxy/IP config) that could push the pilot by ~1 week.
2) Streaming: we need confirmation that Redwood's streaming SDK supports chunked delivery and reconnection for flaky mobile networks. Can Rishi or Dev confirm capability / effort?
3) Structured outputs: our product team will provide a first-pass schema by 2027-04-15. Will that be sufficient to finalize the tool-calling contract?

Also attaching our internal infra runbook excerpt so you can see how we handle outbound connections (will share full IP list once we scope).

Alice Zhang
Platform Lead, Acme Logistics
alice.zhang@acme.com

Looping you all in — Alice asked the streaming reconnection question and confirmed a 2027-04-15 schema delivery. Please see the action items below and add estimates to the MAP workbook (column: Redwood dev effort, days).

Internal breakdown / asks (please reply inline):
- Dev (SDK integration): estimate for implementing install flow + auth + sample app (dev estimate) and confirm support for chunked streaming/reconnect. Also list any proxy special-casing needed.
- Rishi (Streaming): confirm server-side streaming behavior and whether we can provide a mobile-friendly reconnection token/offset so ACME can resume mid-response. Also confirm throughput expectations for pilot (we estimated 2x 100 concurrent sessions).
- Laura (Tool calling / structured outputs): confirm what you need from ACME's schema to finalize contracts and whether Redwood will generate client-side validation helpers.

Proposed internal deadlines (so we hit customer target close 2027-05-15):
- 2027-04-08: Redwood internal scoping complete (estimates in workbook)
- 2027-04-15: ACME provides structured outputs schema (customer)
- 2027-04-22: Proof-of-concept SDK sample and streaming smoke test
- 2027-05-06: Feature-complete internal build (Redwood)
- 2027-05-15: Integration plan signed off / target close

Please reply with your estimates and any red flags by EOD Monday, Apr 5.

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call MAP draft: Integration build plan (owners + next steps)

Marissa / team / Alice — quick update from engineering:

- SDK integration (owner): I can own the client / sample app + install/auth flow. Estimated effort: 8 dev-days for sample + install docs, 5 dev-days to add the streamlined auth flow into our SDKs (total ~13 dev-days).
- Streaming: Redwood SDK already supports chunked delivery and reconnection semantics via a resume token for in-flight responses — we can expose that to the client. Rishi and I will add a mobile reconnection guide. Minimal server changes expected; estimate 4 dev-days to add explicit resume token headers and 2 QA days for flaky network tests.
- Proxy/IP: if ACME requires a corporate proxy we may need a small shim; estimate 3 dev-days to validate proxy flow + docs.
- Structured outputs / tool-calling: Laura to confirm exact shape, but we can generate client-side helpers once we receive schema. I recommend we lock the schema by 2027-04-15 to keep schedule.

Given these estimates and assuming no major security review delays, internal feature-complete by 2027-05-06 looks achievable. I'll update the MAP workbook with the numbers and add an internal owner column.

Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer | Redwood Inference
